tasks.1: Your kart is a set of variables. Change a string (its name), integers (speed, acceleration and grip) and a list (its colour) with the GUI, then hack the code to change them there, where every variable can be seen. Finish with a first safe AI request for a change in the game, then check what the AI did.
tasks.2: Design a kart on a budget. Share exactly 100 points between speed, acceleration and grip in the code, prove the game rejects bad designs (invalid and boundary test data), then predict a lap time, race, and use the evidence to justify the design.
tasks.3: Write a Python brain that drives the kart by itself. It must run without errors, make decisions with if / elif / else, use a function of your own and remember a state between ticks. Upload it (U), switch autopilot on (P) and watch it lap.
tasks.4: Improve the game itself with AI. Write a safe, precise request to change a game rule, predict what it will do, then review the AI's code: does it work, was it tested, can you explain it? Then find a mistake hidden in AI-written code.
tasks.5: Bring everything together for the class grand prix: a final design and an uploaded brain, one new feature of your own made with AI, then evaluate what worked using evidence from the races and explain your code to the group.

boost_pad: A boost button on the floor by the east wall: the robot that touches it is faster for 3 seconds, then the button rests for 5 seconds
double_flipper: A flipper robot has a second flipper on its back end: both lift when it fires
flame_pit: A pit of flames in the middle of the arena: the flames rise while a robot is in it, and after 3 seconds in the pit the robot is deactivated
hammer_slam: A hammer robot jumps and slams down: the robot it hits goes flying and takes fall damage
no_cage: No walls round the arena: a drop into a gutter all the way round (the wall spikes rest)
ramps: Two ramps facing each other across the arena, each with a speed-burst pad: drive up one to fly through the air, and a robot that lands on another robot body slams it, so it goes flying and takes damage
repair_bay: A lit square on the floor by the west wall: a robot on it gets 5 armour back a second, and every 3 seconds on it one lost part goes back on
spike_pit: A square pit of spikes in the floor: a robot pushed in is stuck there and its armour drains away
